acceptance.assertion: Bureau derives a bounded explicit parent-child projection from validated task metadata and rejects malformed, missing or cyclic relations without inferring delegation from title similarity.

A ready parent task with one or more explicit nonterminal child tasks is non-claimable unless a reviewed task contract marks the parent as independently executable; what-now, explain-next, claim-intent and coordinated pickup report the same stable blocker and exact child IDs.
Verified or otherwise terminal child tasks do not block their parent; blocked or planned children remain visible with their own blocker or capability requirements and are not silently promoted.
Regression coverage reproduces REPOGROUND-LEGACY-RECONCILIATION-V1-T004 with T009-T012, T014 and T017 and proves that the umbrella is not handed to an operator while unresolved child work remains.
The projection changes selection and explanation only; it never closes, verifies, queues, reprioritizes or dispatches a child task automatically.
Targeted tests, full Bureau validation, git diff --check and a head/diff-bound self-review pass on the exact implementation head before merge.

approval.note: Follow-up from a live coordinated pickup that safely refused to broaden an umbrella task into already registered child scopes.

goal: Prevent what-now, explain-next and coordinated claim paths from selecting a broad parent task when explicit nonterminal child tasks already carry its unresolved work; instead expose the exact child set and the reason the parent is not directly executable.

does_not_establish: that every metadata.parent_task relation delegates all parent acceptance
automatic closure or verification of a parent task
permission to alter terminal task history

title: Block umbrella pickup while explicit child work remains
